stackDivergence.rationale: Task88 implements actual ScMatrixToken, ScMatrixCellResultToken and ScMatrixFormulaCellToken over the real ScMatrix and shared FormulaToken/primitive tokens. Original nullable matrix/token identity, shallow transport copies, formula numeric upper-left cloning, dimensions with signed16/32 narrowing, result reset/equality/numeric updates and overload-specific Assign aliases are retained. Generic FormulaToken Assign of an actual matrix result shares its numeric token; typed matrix-result Assign clones it (CALC-075). An explicit FormulaToken type witness preserves erased argument overloads, and qualified base prototype calls preserve nonvirtual native receiver selection. ScMatrixRef/ScConstMatrixRef are type-only ordinary JS aliases, no Boost/refcount/allocator/finalizer library. Native complete original class/member scopes over genuine formula headers and verified original matrix constructor/storage context run normally only; source identities and whole value/identity/payload stream checked, no native memory bookkeeping, ABI/debug assertions/full QA claim. Actual ScFormulaResult/ScFormulaCell/document/storage/editing/UI/ODS, matrix-range/reference tokens and unrelated interpreter features remain pending. UI/ODS prerequisite priority and full91 retained.
